buildroot.checksum_provenance: SHA256 calculated from official HTTPS release archive on 2026-10-01

libc.origin: validated external R5900 Linux toolchain; GNU glibc ABI required

base.purpose: GNU command-line runtime, administration, storage recovery, networking diagnostics, SSH clients and data tools; no X server or additional boot daemons

desktop.purpose: Base plus on-demand Xorg, PS2-themed TWM, xterm, bitmap fonts and selectable evdev keyboard layouts (US/ANSI default)

development.purpose: Desktop plus native GNU build/debug suite; disk and swap required

dependency_lock: All recursive package versions, source hashes and patches are pinned inside the SHA256-locked Buildroot release. packages-resolved.json is produced after building.

backend_extensions.scope: External GCC16 version selection and capability chain only; backend host compiler and all stock recipes remain pinned
